title: Agent Orchestration & Core
summary: This module defines the core abstract agent interface, its declarative specification, and the graph nodes responsible for orchestrating agent runs, including processing user input, making model requests, and executing tool calls.

nodes.label: Define Agent Interface
nodes.title: AbstractAgent
nodes.description: Abstract base for agents, defining core properties and execution methods for running, streaming, and managing agent behavior.

nodes.label: Wrap Agent Behavior
nodes.title: WrapperAgent
nodes.description: A concrete agent implementation that delegates all its properties and methods to an underlying wrapped agent, enabling easy extension.

nodes.label: Configure Agent Declaratively
nodes.title: AgentSpec
nodes.description: Represents a declarative specification for configuring an agent using YAML or JSON, including model, instructions, and capabilities.

nodes.label: Process User Input & Prompts
nodes.title: UserPromptNode
nodes.description: Initializes an agent run by processing user prompts, system instructions, and deferred tool results, determining the next step in the graph.

nodes.label: Request LLM Response
nodes.title: ModelRequestNode
nodes.description: Manages communication with the underlying language model, handling request preparation, execution (streaming/non-streaming), and response processing.

nodes.label: Execute Tool Calls
nodes.title: Tool Call Execution
nodes.description: Processes and executes tool calls requested by the LLM, handling successful returns, deferred calls, denied calls, and retries.

nodes.label: Capture Agent Run Messages
nodes.title: capture_run_messages
nodes.description: A context manager to capture and access the message history generated during an agent's run, useful for debugging and error handling.

nodes.label: Instantiate Capabilities
nodes.title: _instantiate_cap
nodes.description: A utility function for instantiating capability classes from their type and arguments, applying validation from a specification.

nodes.label: LLM Providers & Models
nodes.title: model_providers_and_wrappers
nodes.description: Provides interfaces and wrappers for various Large Language Models and their providers.

nodes.label: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: capabilities_and_tools
nodes.description: Defines abstract capabilities and concrete tool implementations that agents can utilize.

nodes.label: Graph Execution Engine
nodes.title: graph_execution_engine
nodes.description: Provides the underlying graph execution framework for orchestrating agent steps.

groups.label: Agent Core Definitions
groups.title: Agent Core Definitions
groups.description: Defines the fundamental structure and configuration mechanisms for agents.

groups.label: Agent Orchestration Flow
groups.title: Agent Orchestration Flow
groups.description: Components responsible for processing user input, interacting with LLMs, and executing tools within an agent's run.

groups.label: Agent Utilities
groups.title: Agent Utilities
groups.description: Helper components supporting agent functionality, such as message capture and capability instantiation.
